sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Hungarian verbs change according to the subject. In the indefinite present, common first-person forms often end in -ok/-ek/-ök.

Rather than memorizing dozens of endings in the abstract, pick one verb you use constantly and drill its full first-person form until it’s automatic — tanulok for ‘I study’ is a solid anchor. Once one verb’s rhythm is locked in, new ones slot into the same shape far faster.
